rationale: The branch IAT hook resolves Direct3DCreate9Ex from the same d3d9 provider that supplied Direct3DCreate9 and explicitly allows third-party provider-local Ex.
The pinned stock DXVK 3.1.1 x86 d3d9.dll exports Direct3DCreate9Ex.
A successful promotion can reuse the existing four-slot D3D9Ex-to-D3D11 zero-copy transport and is a smaller, better-isolated test than designing a new transport immediately.
The test also discriminates the DX9Ex vehicle-color issue: if color regresses only after provider-local Ex promotion, the Ex compatibility/state layer becomes the primary suspect.
runtime_probe_candidate.collector_hardening: V4 ad-hoc package uses a detached finalizer plus manual COLLECT_DXVK_EX_LOGS_NOW.cmd fallback so forced game termination can still seal logs and restore managed files.

collector_fix.issue: Portable V4 collector used an in-session filesystem lock while compressing the same session tree; the lock could block Compress-Archive and a stale lock could prevent retry.
fix: Replace filesystem lock with a named cross-process mutex that is automatically released if the collector dies.
Copy the complete sealed session into an external temporary staging directory before compression.
On normal game exit run synchronous collection in addition to the detached watcher; the mutex de-duplicates them.
Keep a manual retry command for the same session; it refuses to restore while the game PID is still alive.
Create FINALIZED.ok only after non-zero ZIP creation and SHA256 verification.
